text_block_list.text:
Showing off her strengths to the fullest, 
Mejiro Bright ran a magnificent race 
without letting herself be overwhelmed by 
the grand stage of the Japanese Derby.

Seeing Mejiro Bright stay true to her own 
running, Silence Suzuka broke through her 
hesitation and vowed to go see the scenery 
she truly wanted to see.

Mejiro Bright's next goal is the Kikuka 
Sho. She stated that there couldn't 
possibly be any other choice.

For the Mejiro family, who place great 
value on prestigious races like the Tenno 
Sho and the Classic Triple Crown, the 
Kikuka Sho is a race that cannot be 
missed.

What the Mejiro family desires is what she 
desires— Mejiro Bright's resolve was 
unshakeable.
